title: Coordinate conditional absolute moment
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability distribution $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\Omega^n$. For a real number $p$, coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and input $x\in\Omega^n$, define the coordinate conditional absolute moment as the expectation over $\omega\sim\pi$ of $|f(x_{-i},\omega)-m|^p$, where $m$ is the expectation of $f(x_{-i},\omega)$ and $x_{-i}$ denotes $x$ with coordinate $i$ replaced by $\omega$.
hypotheses_covered: finite alphabet Ω with probability distribution π
